title: Monday Standup
goal: Deliver a clear status update covering what you completed, what you're working on, and any blockers. Answer 2 follow-up questions clearly.
hint: In a standup, always cover 3 things: what you completed, what you're working on now, and any blockers (problems stopping you). Keep it short and clear!
opening_message: Good morning! Ready for our Monday standup. Who wants to go first? PM, what's your update?
